def solution(full_text, search_text):
    count = 0
    start = 0
    len_search = len(search_text)
    len_full = len(full_text)
    while start <= len_full - len_search:
        if full_text[start:start+len_search] == search_text:
            count += 1
            start += len_search
        else:
            start += 1
    return count
